title: Daiwa BG LT 3000D-XH Real-World Line Capacity Test
seoTitle: Daiwa BG LT 3000D-XH Line Capacity Test | ReelCalc
description: We spooled 12 lb Trilene XL and 20 lb J-Braid X4 on a Daiwa BG LT 3000D-XH. See the measured fills, 220-yard overfills, and what the diameter markings explain.
hubExcerpt: Online specs said 220 yards of 12 lb mono or 20 lb braid. The box and spool told us more. See what happened when we tried both lines.

runs.name: Berkley Trilene XL 12 lb
runs.extraRoomObservation: The angler confirmed there was clearly room for roughly another 18 yards, bringing the fill to about 160 yards in line with the 0.33 mm spool rating. A separate 160-yard fill was not measured or photographed.

runs.name: Daiwa J-Braid X4 20 lb
runs.extraRoomObservation: The first stop at 166.8 yards was a comfortable fill. The angler judged that a little more could have been added if needed while staying comfortable, but definitely not 220 yards. No additional comfortable-fill amount was measured; 220 yards was visibly overfilled.

evidenceNote: The supplied factory-box and empty-spool close-ups verify all six physical capacity rows. Test photos remain unaltered.
